regime_context: The detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the thin leader (narrow breadth, moderate durability) with Industrial Metals close behind and exhibiting much broader participation. The absolute-trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown in China A-shares, so trend-following carries above-average whipsaw risk.
emerging_watch: Watching for Industrial Metals (512400.SS) to overtake AI Compute & Optics in the detector's weekly rotation score for two consecutive weeks; until then, the AI theme's fragile leadership remains unbroken.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Leadership is fragile: breadth is only 0.12 and durability a moderate 0.53, while the trend gate – which the detector relies on for risk control – did not cut drawdown in this market's history. A close challenger (Industrial Metals) with far better breadth and durability is compressing the margin to just 0.063. Adding to a narrow, fragile leader invites whipsaw losses.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate failed to reduce drawdown per backtest_verdict
rotation margin to Industrial Metals only 0.063, breadth of rotation narrowing
theses.dissent: The macro AI narrative dominates headlines and the theme is not crowded; the thinness may simply reflect concentrated high-quality names, allowing the trend to persist if sentiment holds.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS (AI Compute proxy) holds above its 20-day moving average and outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 5% over the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals rank second but offer the strongest trend-health among eligible themes: durability of 0.81 and broad breadth of 0.85 suggest a resilient uptrend that is not yet crowded. The narrow margin to the leader (0.063) positions it as the most viable challenger if the AI theme stumbles. We lean overweight on relative risk-reward, while fully acknowledging that the failed gate means even healthy trends can mean-revert abruptly.
evidence: durability_bar 0.81, Hurst tag 'trend' – one of the strongest durability readings
breadth 0.846, the highest among top-ranked themes
rotation margin to leader just 0.063, absorption of 0.34 indicating room for shift
theses.dissent: The gate's historical failure means strong trends can still suffer sharp drawdowns; the narrow margin may never convert to a confirmed handoff, leaving the trade range-bound or reversing before leadership changes.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS (Industrial Metals proxy) drops below its 20-day simple moving average and underperforms the CSI 300 by 3% or more within the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Strong trend metrics (durability 0.79, breadth 0.93) are offset by elevated crowding (z=1.26). Per guardrails, crowding is a sizing-down caution – never a fade, but enough to warrant avoidance. In a market where the trend gate failed, crowded trends may be especially susceptible to sharp corrections, so we step aside.
evidence: crowding_z 1.26, crowded true – among the highest crowding readings
durability_bar 0.79 and breadth 0.929 indicate strong trend, heightening crowding risk if the trend breaks
gate_helps false, implying mean-reversion risk that could punish crowded positions
theses.dissent: High durability and broad participation could support the trend even under elevated attention; structural healthcare innovation drivers may justify the crowding and lead to further gains.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Pharma & CXO proxy) rises more than 3% relative to the CSI 300 over the 20-day horizon and its crowding_z does not exceed 2.0 during that period.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
